name: Force fixed-budget thinking (disable adaptive) on main API path
description: Forces Claude Code's main API request path to always use fixed-budget enabled thinking instead of model-default adaptive thinking. Reverse-engineered from the Frisch12 gist (versioned for 2.1.101/2.1.108), which forces the adaptive-vs-budget selector in services/api/claude.ts to take its else-branch (the Math.min(maxOutputTokens-1, budget) `type:"enabled"` path). On 2.1.158 the selector was refactored into a single ternary condition; this patch rewrites that 39-char condition to a same-length comma-expression that always evaluates to false, so the budgeted-thinking else-branch is always taken. The model thinking-capability gate is preserved. Note: the gist's three additional subagent edits (`{type:"adaptive"}` -> `{type:"enabled",budget_tokens:N}`) are length-changing and are intentionally not applied here; the main-path edit is the substantive behavioral driver.

operations.rationale: Force the main API-path adaptive-vs-budget thinking selector to always take its else-branch (fixed budgeted type:'enabled' via Math.min(maxOutputTokens-1, budget)), matching the gist's patch-1 intent. The 39-char ternary condition is replaced with a same-length comma-expression that references the in-scope vars (Dq,Y,j6) for harmlessness and always yields !1 (false).
